produced_by: Council of AI — no measurement was run by CSOAI for this record; see what_this_is
what_this_is: A dated, sourced record of the benchmark numbers other parties have published for one frontier model, so that the number can be cited, compared and later replaced by a CSOAI run when a funded credential exists. Every row carries its own provenance class and its own source URL.
what_this_does_not_establish: That CSOAI measured GPT-6.1 Terra. It did not. Every number here is someone else's number.

That any two rows are comparable. They are not: different harnesses, different item sets, different effort settings, different graders. The comparable column states, per row, whether a like-for-like counterpart exists at all.

Any ranking of GPT-6.1 Terra against CSOAI's own models. The public board excludes our own models from the fleet by rule, and Terra is not measured on any CSOAI bank, so the comparison is UNMEASURED in both directions.
That the vendor numbers are reproducible by a third party. The vendor numbers are VENDOR_REPORTED; they have not been reproduced here.

provenance_vocabulary.VENDOR_REPORTED_VIA_SEARCH_INDEX: The publisher's page could not be fetched by an automated client (HTTP 403, Cloudflare challenge). The value was read from a search index of that page. NOT read from the page's own bytes — treat as second-hand.
provenance_vocabulary.INDEPENDENT_FROM_PRIMARY_BYTES: A third party's own run, read by CSOAI from that party's own published artefact (bytes pinned below).
provenance_vocabulary.INDEPENDENT_VIA_PRESS_RELEASE: A third party's own run, read from that party's own press release rather than its results table.
provenance_vocabulary.UNMEASURED: No run exists. Not zero, not a score, not a ranking position.

comparison_to_csoai.method: Two separate questions, answered separately. (1) Like-for-like on CSOAI's own banks: does the estate hold a measurement of GPT-6.1 Terra on the same bank, graded by the same grader, with the same denominator? (2) Like-for-like on public benchmarks: does CSOAI hold a measurement of its own model on the same public benchmark, on the same release, under the same effort setting?

question_1_own_banks.detail: GPT-6.1 Terra has never been run on a CSOAI bank. The harvested queue slot says UNMEASURED. There is no card, no per-item row and no signed record for it. The board therefore has no Terra cell on any of its 14 model-comparison axes, and none is invented here.
question_1_own_banks.the_one_line_needed_to_close_it: One run of harness/bench/run_bench.py against csoai/gspc-gov (237 items) with a funded OpenRouter or OpenAI credential, graded by the mill's read_label, publishing the per-item ledger. That produces the comparable number and nothing else does.

question_2_public_benchmarks.detail: The estate holds no published CSOAI measurement of any CSOAI model on Terminal-Bench 4.0, MMMU-Pro, OSWorld 2.1, Agents' Last Exam, Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, HealthBench, MentalHealthBench, ExploitBench, SEC-Bench Pro or the DualEntry Accounting AI Benchmark. There is therefore no CSOAI-vs-Terra comparison on any of those benchmarks to be had, in either direction, without first running one.

what_the_boards_own_banks_do_say.note: For the record, these are the CSOAI-side numbers that do exist, read from the signed card corpus. They are CSOAI measurements of CSOAI's own models on CSOAI's own banks. They are not comparable to any Terra number above, because Terra has no number on those banks.

governance_axis_public_external_fleet.method: exact McNemar on the discordant items, leader vs the best base model, our own models removed from the fleet before comparison

what_the_boards_own_banks_do_say.own_model_cards_note: These are in-lane results on our own models. The public board does not rank our own models and does not count them in totals.separated_leads. They are printed here so the Terra comparison has a CSOAI side to point at, not because they compete with anything on this page.

how_the_terra_run_is_built.harness: an Inspect eval on a frozen 24-item statute-anchored governance probe (harness/tasks/gspc_governance.py): deterministic exact-token grading, no model judges another model, and an unreadable answer is UNMEASURED (NOANSWER) rather than wrong
how_the_terra_run_is_built.credential_needed: OPENROUTER_API_KEY with credit (the key on this machine authenticates but answers chat completions with HTTP 402 'This account never purchased credits')

precedent.the_record_s_own_limits: n=24 is below the harness interval-publication threshold of usable_n>=30, so no confidence interval, rank, certification or independent separation claim is asserted; and MEOK and CSOAI/GSPC are affiliated, so this is an operator-run comparison, not independent leaderboard confirmation

how_the_terra_run_is_built.the_arm_split_must_accompany_the_number: MEOK is not a bare model behind an API: on a probe the MEOK arm was observed answering with routed_model gspc-statutory-arbiter-seat13, a deterministic statutory arbiter route rather than a model. A like-for-like comparison must publish, beside the score, how many items each arm answered without a model. The estate already has the tooling (benchmark/federation/probe-bench-arm-split.mjs) that computes the split from a record's own per-item ledgers.
